name: Kakizaki Megu
source:
Instance of Kakizaki Megu in NOMAD Rozen Maiden continuation, which is also used in TAITO Visual Novels.
She is a sickly girl, who is suffering from a congenital heart disease, and who is also the medium of Suigintou.
